summary: Split tally/reports.py into the tally/reports/ package (errors, tables, state, system, formatting, model, loading, aggregate, renderers, cli, plus a re-exporting __init__), with every file under 400 lines, no import cycles or layer violations, and state and patch points held in state.py and system.py. The 63 tests pass with only the mock.patch targets updated, and 744 CLI runs compared against the original gave identical stdout, stderr and exit status.
